kevin: Morning — quick sunrise sync. Dropping a short log digest + PR pings. What I did / blockers / today:
kevin: Did — rolled autoscaler tweak to reduce cold targets, canaryed in staging (20% traffic). Observed 95p tail down ~12%.
kevin: Blocker — noisy alerts from eu-west demo cluster (routing-proxy) are spamming the channel, makes it hard to spot real pages.
kevin: Today — tune alert thresholds, review PR #432 (batcher backpressure fix), finalize handoff notes for tonight's oncall.
anika: Nice! Saw the canary metrics. Can you paste the prom query you used for the dashboard? :thumbsup:
kevin: Sure — pasted below (quick PromQL):
kevin: ```sum(rate(http_request_duration_seconds_bucket{job="routing-proxy"}[5m])) by (le) / sum(rate(http_request_duration_seconds_count{job="routing-proxy"}[5m])) by (le)```
jordan: FYI oncall log: got two 502/timeout alerts from routing-proxy overnight (01:12 and 03:47). I muted the noisy route rule and created SRE-1987 for a follow-up. Attached brief runbook steps in the ticket.
maya: I have a small observability PR that adds p50/p95/p99 to model-serving latencies (helps with the tail). Pinged @kevin for review on #439.
maria: Taking handoff at 18:00 UTC. No active pages right now, but I'll monitor eu-west and the dedicated pool. If anything spikes, I'll escalate.
sre-bot: [alert-suppressor] Suppressed repeated alert: routing-proxy_eu-west_demo high error rate at 10:15 UTC — suppression window 30m.
kevin: Thanks — actions so far: 1) anika to add dashboard link to the PR and include the prom query; 2) jordan to attach runbook snippet to SRE-1987; 3) maya to rebase obs PR and request review; 4) maria to watch tonight and escalate if errors > 1% for 10m.
kevin: Quick note — PR #432 is small, should be a 5-10 min review. Dropping the link here: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/432
anika: I'll add the dashboard link and a short description of the metric buckets.
jordan: Added runbook excerpt to SRE-1987 and flagged the timeout rule for tuning.
maya: Rebased #439 and added test snapshots for percentiles.
maria: Got it. I'll post a handoff summary at 17:55 UTC with watch conditions and contact links.
kevin: TL;DR: autoscaler tweak rolled, canary looks good, noisy eu-west alerts being suppressed and tracked via SRE-1987, PR review + obs work in flight. Short replies only please so the channel stays scannable. :eyes:
